profile.name: Sampath Kumar
profile.title: B.E. CSE (AI & ML) Student '27 | Aspiring AI Researcher
profile.location: India | Target: US MS in AI / CS
profile.bio: Undergraduate student pursuing B.E. in CSE with specialization in AI & Machine Learning (Batch of 2027). Dedicated to building scalable Deep Learning architectures, Climate AI models, and LLM systems. Seeking MS in AI/CS with Graduate Research Assistantship (RA).

projects.title: AI Climate Anomaly Detection & Prediction System
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack research-level AI system streaming real-time climate metrics, forecasting 7-day temperature trends with ARIMA, and detecting weather anomalies with Isolation Forest.
projects.fullDescription: Engineered an end-to-end meteorological intelligence pipeline. Combines real-time OpenWeatherAPI stream ingestion with ARIMA time-series forecasting (0.42°C MAE) and unsupervised Isolation Forest anomaly detection (93.8% precision for extreme heatwaves/rainfall). Served via FastAPI microservices to Streamlit & Next.js dashboards.
projects.impact: 93.8% Anomaly Precision | 0.42°C Forecasting MAE | 2,400 req/min FastAPI Throughput

projects.title: Autonomous Neural Navigation Agent
projects.shortDescription: Deep Q-Learning & Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) neural agent for autonomous mobile robot navigation.
projects.fullDescription: Engineered an end-to-end reinforcement learning model using PyTorch integrated with ROS2 and Gazebo simulator. Achieved 94.2% obstacle avoidance success rate across 500 randomized benchmark environments.
projects.impact: 94.2% Success Rate | Reduced Navigation Latency by 35%

projects.title: Vision Transformer Medical Imaging Classifier
projects.shortDescription: Automated medical imaging diagnostic pipeline using Vision Transformers (ViT) with Grad-CAM.
projects.fullDescription: Trained ViT and EfficientNet models on MIMIC-CXR dataset (100k+ images) achieving 0.91 AUC score for pneumonia detection. Deployed model via FastAPI microservices with Grad-CAM visual explanations.

projects.title: LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Code Reviewer
projects.shortDescription: Autonomous multi-agent system performing automated code quality audits and security analysis.
projects.fullDescription: Built an autonomous multi-agent pipeline utilizing quantized Llama 3 models and FAISS vector index. Analyzes git pull requests for vulnerability patterns, style compliance, and memory leaks.
projects.impact: Detects 88% of common security vulnerabilities automatically
